$Comment: Adds 880 to the Great Turkey's maximum health on the hard way in while its hard fight has at least 3 players in it: the hard twin of Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Scale_Health_P3. Its hard fight's script applies it as the Great Turkey rises, one step per player up to 5, then refills it (Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Scale_TopUp), since a higher maximum leaves its current health where it was. It stays on the Great Turkey for the whole fight. Amount is the health one more player adds; change the four steps together.
